raw.query: WITH live_data AS (SELECT policy, ttft_p99_ms AS live_ttft_p99, replica_seconds AS live_replica_seconds FROM provenance.v_live_anchor), twin_data AS (SELECT 'forecast' AS policy, lat.p99_ms AS twin_ttft_p99, cost.provisioned_worker_seconds AS twin_replica_seconds FROM provenance.v_pool_latency lat JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost cost USING (run_id) WHERE lat.is_current = true AND lat.run_id = 'live:twin_fc_p90_cap4' AND lat.sla_metric = 'ttft' UNION ALL SELECT 'reactive' AS policy, lat.p99_ms AS twin_ttft_p99, cost.provisioned_worker_seconds AS twin_replica_seconds FROM provenance.v_pool_latency lat JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost cost USING (run_id) WHERE lat.is_current = true AND lat.run_id = 'live:twin_re_cap4' AND lat.sla_metric = 'ttft') SELECT l.policy, l.live_ttft_p99, t.twin_ttft_p99, ROUND(((l.live_ttft_p99 - t.twin_ttft_p99) / t.twin_ttft_p99 * 100)::numeric, 4) AS ttft_pct_diff, l.live_replica_seconds, t.twin_replica_seconds, ROUND(((l.live_replica_seconds - t.twin_replica_seconds) / t.twin_replica_seconds * 100)::numeric, 4) AS replica_pct_diff FROM live_data l JOIN twin_data t ON l.policy = t.policy;
raw.claimed: TTFT p99 within 1.1-6.8%, provisioned replica-time within 8%
raw.evidence: Live validation (v_live_anchor) vs twin simulations (v_pool_latency and v_pool_cost) shows TTFT differences of 1.05% and 6.76% (matching the 1.1-6.8% range when rounded), and replica-time differences of -7.64% and -5.26% (both within 8%). Prior verifier hy3 compared two simulated twins instead of comparing live to simulation.
